_readme: The registry of CLAIMS this repository has WITHDRAWN, and the spellings that must not reappear. WFG-062. One entry per withdrawn claim: what was withdrawn, the artifact or escalation that withdrew it, the pragma tokens that license a deliberate mention, and the banned spellings. scripts/check_withdrawn_claims.py checks EVERY tracked .md and .html against every entry; tests/test_withdrawn_claims_registry.py is the gate. Adding a claim here gates it across the whole tree at once: that is the point of the file. See docs/withdrawn_claims.md for what it does and does NOT do.

scope._readme: The default is EVERY tracked .md and .html file. `record_prefixes` is the one exception class and every member carries a reason: these are the files whose job is to QUOTE a withdrawn claim in order to record that it was withdrawn. No judge reads them. A path may not be both a record path and a member of a hand-rolled guard list in tests/test_detection_ordering_is_not_claimed.py; the gate refuses that.

record_prefixes.why: every lap's report; their subject is often the claim that was withdrawn that lap
retired documents, kept under CHARTER §3 rule 7 (never delete) precisely as a record
the lessons file; a lesson about a withdrawn claim has to name it
escalations quote the claim they are asking the author about (NH-019 is one)
rows quote the withdrawn sentence as the row's own definition of done
the critic's series table quotes findings verbatim
the current critic findings, which name the claims they found
the readiness lines carry the finding history against each tick
the direction page quotes the critic's notes verbatim
the standing brief cites the claims as worked examples of its own rules
the verbatim routine prompts, a record by construction (CHARTER §9)
generated by scripts/auto/report.py from BACKLOG.md, which is itself a record path

claims.title: the satellite/telephone ordering
claims.claim: 위성 트리거가 사람의 신고보다 늦었다 (또는 빨랐다) — 어느 방향이든
claims.withdrawn_by: WFG-053 (dev lap 20260904T0419Z); the reference clock is the manifest's 기록된 발생일시, and no 신고접수시각 exists in this repository. Escalated and settled as NH-019.
claims.say_instead: the size floor: a 2 km pixel does not resolve a fire below roughly a hectare, which is true under either reading

spellings.why: the card's withdrawn front sentence 「위성은 사람보다 느렸습니다」, in any verb
the OPPOSITE ordering claim. Neither direction is available: the human's clock was never measured, so 「위성이 사람보다 빨랐다」 is exactly as unsupported
the delays labelled as report-relative; they are recorded-occurrence-relative
any delay or step stated relative to a 신고 time that was never measured
the same label one synonym over

the SAME withdrawn heading in the other word order — 「기준이 신고 시각이므로」. Found live at docs/SESSION19_REPORT.md:229 and :293 by the independent reviewer of dev lap 20260904T2119Z, three lines from a line this row had just licensed, which is why it is registered rather than left as a stated limit. It is registered because a reviewer who did not write the patterns found the spelling IN THE TREE; a spelling the pattern's author invents and then grades with its own sentence is leakage.
